data.title: Tropical Storm Odalys (EP1), advisory 27/1444Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: ODALYS QUICKLY SPINNING DOWN. ...EXPECTED TO BECOME A POST-TROPICAL CYCLONE BY TONIGHT... As of 8:00 AM PDT Sun Sep 27 the center of Odalys was located near 22.6, -123.4 with movement N at 6 mph. The minimum central pressure was 992 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 60 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Eighteen-E (EP3), advisory 27/1444Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: TROPICAL DEPRESSION EIGHTEEN-E FORECAST TO STRENGTHEN WHILE IT REMAINS OFFSHORE THE COAST OF SOUTHERN MEXICO. As of 9:00 AM CST Sun Sep 27 the center of Eighteen-E was located near 12.7, -98.6 with movement WNW at 5 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1006 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Fay (AT1), advisory 27/1438Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY DRIFTING SOUTH-SOUTHEASTWARD. As of 3:00 PM GMT Sun Sep 27 the center of Fay was located near 29.3, -43.8 with movement SSE at 3 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1010 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 27/1746Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: NOAA HURRICANE HUNTERS INVESTIGATING POLO. ...PREPARATIONS TO PROTECT LIFE AND PROPERTY SHOULD BE RUSHED TO COMPLETION TODAY IN BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR AS POWERFUL POLO APPROACHES... As of 11:00 AM MST Sun Sep 27 the center of Polo was located near 21.3, -114.0 with movement NNW at 12 mph. The minimum central pressure was 950 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 125 mph.
